proposition.claim:
The angular coordinate change is O(epsilon)-close in derivative to the Kerr map, its angular Jacobian extends continuously at the Cauchy horizon in old compactified coordinates, and continuous S-tangent tensors transfer to the new coordinates; Theorem 16.14 invokes these assertions.

Exact Kerr compared with itself, so every initial-data difference and all weighted norms vanish. Strict 0<a<M; any fixed allowed delta>0, large N, small epsilon and corresponding sufficiently negative u_f. Start sequences late enough for u+v>=C_R and compactifying-coordinate formula. Equator in both specified chart interiors; no endpoint or chart-boundary exception.

Smooth strictly decreasing u and strictly increasing v on the spacelike initial curve suffice for local nonsingular double-null coordinates solving the eikonal equations.

Smooth injective regular curve, derivative (-3tau^2,1) never zero; smooth inverse parameter v; -tau^3 strictly decreasing, tau strictly increasing; radius positive; smooth isometric spacelike embedding.
